string.text: Forward, attack! Let's get these bastards!
Guys, Wolf sent us reinforcements. And an order to attack. So forward, time to be heroes!
We tore them apart!
Why are you standing there, stalker? Want to pass? Come here, we'll talk. Don't make me ask twice.
Brother, come here, I need you. There are soldiers holed up nearby, we need help.
Yeah, we should go check what's going on there.
Radio: Commander, some idiot's wandering down there. Want us to take a shot? Negative. Not worth wasting ammo on small fry. Heh. Let him live.
We'll do everything right, don't worry about that.
Friend, keep it down. Let me explain the situation.
Wolf, the factory is cleared. We're moving to our starting positions. Over and out.
Stop right there!
Hey, anyone alive out there? Should I keep sitting here, or can I leave now?
Hey guys, are you alive? What's even going on?
Guys, I'm here! Get me out!
Damn, what a day. Is anyone going to rescue me or what?
Thanks, brother. I don't even know how to thank you.
Mister, help me!
Give me a medkit, please.
Give me a medkit, please!
Help me, brother!
Mister, help me!
Thanks, Marked One. I can see you're a decent guy. I'll tell my people at the camp that you helped me.
Come here, I need to explain the situation to you.
Well, why are you standing there? Come on, I don't bite.
Where do you think you're going without a weapon, idiot?
Hey, come here, I've got something for you.
Well, come in, you'll freeze out there.

Sidorovich: Marked One. By the way, about Strelok. A stalker has come back from a deep raid. They call him Fox. He had a rough time, looks like. He's asking for help. He dragged some creatures behind him. Says he won't last long. He may know about Strelok, so run to him. I'm sending you the coordinates.
Well, hello!
Back again?
Brought any loot?
Got something worthwhile?
What did you drag in?
How are things, stalker?
Go on, get out of my sight.
Don't stand there like a statue. Hand over what you brought and get lost.
Are you drunk?
Did you fall asleep?
What's wrong with you today?
Not bad. Good goods.
Good. But will there be more? Come by.
Well done. I'm pleased.
Always like this, please.
Well, good hunting, stalker!
You might as well collect tin cans.
Why are you hauling this junk?
What kind of rubbish did you bring me?
Buddy, don't you get it? I need real goods.
Come over, let's talk!
Guys, I'm sending a man to you. Act as you see fit. If you think it's needed, attack. Over.
All right, Wolf, send him. Just tell him not to hang around here. Over and out.
Great, guys. Moving to positions.
Hand over the cash and artifacts! Quick, you idiot!
What, you moron, don't you get it?
Give us the cash or we'll blow your head off!
Guys, I've got nothing!
No, I have no money and no artifacts!
I have nothing! Don't shoot!
Thanks, friend. I owe you.
Well, you're weak, Marked One. You were no use to us at all. So don't expect any gratitude. There's nothing to thank you for.
Excellent, Marked One. You really helped us a lot. Consider your pass paid for. You can head to the Bar.
Not bad, stalker. You shot some mutants. But you're not exactly quick. So if you want to pass, you'll have to pay.
Attention all. This is Duty at the Garbage. A wave of mutants is moving from Dark Valley toward the Bar. Anyone who helps shoot the vermin has our gratitude. Duty's word.
Stalker, get out of here. We don't let just anyone through.

Gray: Everyone who can hear me, we're being attacked by a group of bandits. We need help. Brothers, help us, it's lawless out here. The bandits have lost their minds. Damn, is anyone nearby? We're about to be finished here.
They're coming! They're coming!

Neutral commander: Attention all! This is the commander of the neutrals' squad. We've driven the bandits out of the abandoned vehicles area. We expect a counterattack. We're short on men, so anyone who can help, join us.
Mole: Everyone who can hear me, guys, help! The military is butchering our fellow stalkers!
Mole: The soldiers have me pinned down in the yard! Save me, brothers!

Thanks, friend. You saved me. I already had one foot in the grave. Listen, the military never leaves a job half done. Special forces will be here soon. We need to get out of here, and fast. Run, I'll lead you out.

Phew, it's quiet here. We can wait until the raid is over. Gray told me what you're looking for. It's somewhere underground around here. I can't say exactly where, I don't know myself. Be careful. Good luck.
Hey, mister, help me! The military is about to wipe out Mole's group! We need help!
Forward, guys!
Let's go! Now!
Sidorovich: Marked One, I told the barkeep about you. He should arrange with Duty to let you through. So get moving and go see him.
Talk, you bitch, or you'll find out how easily a bullet goes through a skull.
No, no, don't kill me! Your partner is about to be taken to the abandoned factory! That's all I know, I swear!
Fine, scum, live. But don't let me see you again.
Hey, buddy, come here. Help me get my partner back from the bandits.
Follow me. I know a place for an ambush. If you help, I'll be grateful. Debts get repaid.
Hide on that side of the road. They'll show up soon. Open fire only after I do.
Here they come. Now we'll get them.
Hey, buddy, come over, I've got business.
Thanks, friend.
Damn it, may the earth rest lightly on you, friend.
Come over, let's talk.
Soon you'll be lunch for the mutants.
Get ready for the buffet, pal. You're the main course.
Come on, move your legs!
Move faster, you creep!
I don't envy you.
Bullet, thanks, friend! I'd already said goodbye to life!
Thank the stalker, he helped me.
Alive and well! Then let's go back to base for backup.
Help!
Groups one and two, check the first floor. Group three, the main hall. Four and five, the second floor.

Listen to me carefully, Baklan. Have you heard the story about Robin Hood? No? What about George the Just? Anyway, your money went to help the poor, got it? Forget about it and get lost. Try squealing and we'll beat you to a pulp. Understand?
Get lost while you're in one piece, loser.
Hey, bro, listen up. I'm making him an offer.
Come on, come on, finish him!
Move, don't just stand there!
Beat him, beat the bastard!
Careful!
Just shoot him!
Finish him, finish him!
Look, look what he's doing!
Wow, what a monster!
Bro, come on! Right between the eyes, between the eyes!
From the side, flank him!
Hello, stalker! Come over, let's talk!
Come on, step over.
Well, buddy, how's it going?
Still alive? Good.
How are you?
How are things, eh?
Well, why are you standing there? Come on over.
Come on over. There's little time.
Go ahead, don't linger.
You can't go in here.
Talk to the barkeep.
Stop! You can't go there right now!
Damn it!
Damn, if only someone would help.
Damn.
How did I get into this!
What the hell was I thinking!
Come over, stalker. For people like you I always have something interesting.
Don't dawdle, mister. My information might be useful to you.
Attention! Volunteers wanted for dangerous but well-paid jobs. Those interested, come to the bar.

Stalkers, if you're looking for a place to grab a bite and rest, a place where you can have a good drink and a talk, a place where they'll always tell you how to earn some money, come to the 100 Rads bar. New visitors are always welcome.
Veterans of Chernobyl, join the ranks of Duty. A huge responsibility lies on us: to protect the world from the growing Zone.

Stalkers, if you're looking for a place to grab a bite and rest, a place where you can have a good drink and a talk, a place where they'll always tell you how to earn some money, come to the 100 Rads bar. New visitors are always welcome.
Free stalkers, veterans and hunters, join the ranks of Duty. Protecting the world from the Zone's infection is our common goal and task.
Stalker, protect the world from the Zone. Join Duty.
The world looks with fear at the spreading infection of the Zone. Join Duty. Help the peaceful people.
Deadly anomalies, dangerous mutants, anarchists and bandits will not stop Duty, marching victoriously to the aid of the peaceful citizens of the whole planet.
Fighting mutants, you will cover yourself in eternal glory. What's more, everyone who joins Duty is provided with weapons and excellent gear.
We believe in our victory! We believe the Zone will be destroyed!
Attention! Volunteers wanted for dangerous but well-paid jobs. Those interested, come to the bar.

Stalkers, if you're looking for a place to grab a bite and rest, a place where you can have a good drink and a talk, a place where they'll always tell you how to earn some money, come to the 100 Rads bar. New visitors are always welcome.
Veterans of Chernobyl, join the ranks of Duty. A huge responsibility lies on us: to protect the world from the growing Zone.
Free stalkers, veterans and hunters, join the ranks of Duty. Protecting the world from the Zone's infection is our common goal and task.
Stalker, protect the world from the Zone. Join Duty.
The world looks with fear at the spreading infection of the Zone. Join Duty. Help the peaceful people.
Deadly anomalies, dangerous mutants, anarchists and bandits will not stop Duty, marching victoriously to the aid of the peaceful citizens of the whole planet.
Fighting mutants, you will cover yourself in eternal glory. What's more, everyone who joins Duty is provided with weapons and excellent gear.
We believe in our victory! We believe the Zone will be destroyed!
Crap. Drunk again.
What am I supposed to do? What the hell do I do?
Well, one more shot.
Wow!
Ugh, damn, day after day the same thing.
Screw it.
Ooh!
When will all this end?
Guess that's fate.
Well, let's drink to him once more. He was a good stalker.
Ugh, that was a lousy run.
Get lost, I'm miserable enough already.
Heeey!
Do you respect me?
Go your own way, stalker.
We need to recruit new fighters.
If they do that, we'll do this. Yeah, and if not? Damn.
Oh, it's hard to wage a war alone.
Come on over, since you came.
What did you come for?
Go ahead, don't linger.
Go on through, go on.
Don't hang around, mister.
Don't get in the way!
Hm, so, if they poke their heads in, we'll...
We forgive the anarchists too much. Yes.
It's about time to restore order.
The guys are tired, of course. But we can't relax. We can't.
Yes.
So, this is worth taking into account.
They won't wait.
Hello, brother. Tell me why you came.
Why are you standing there? Out with it, why did you come?
Wolfhound, I don't get it. Did he alone shoot all our snipers?
Got it, got it. Sending them now.
I see Kruglov near the construction site. We'll take him now.

Marked One, there's a hot anomaly ahead in the tunnel. We need to go one at a time, that gives us a better chance of surviving. You go first. When I see you've reached the end, I'll follow. Watch out for fire traps. You can spot them by the distortion of the hot air.
Stalker, help! We were returning to Yantar when mercenaries ambushed us. They say they need information, but I know they'll shoot us all.
As you say, Marked One, only you go first and I'll follow. I'm a poor fighter, you'd better scout the way.
Finally we're safe. Thank you for your help. I owe you. Take this flash drive for now. It's a copy of the results of the last expedition. I'm sure the barkeep will pay well for this information.
If you come to our mobile lab at Yantar, we'll give you a scientific suit.
Ambush! Ambush!
Let's hurry while there's nobody around.
Kruglov: If you attack, I will destroy the information.
Kruglov: If you don't want me to destroy the research results, stay away.
Kruglov: Stalker, help! Mercenaries attacked us. Half of our people are dead. Help us, we'll repay you.
Kruglov: Help us break through the ambush near the plant. I've sent you the coordinates. Be careful, Wolfhound and his thugs are near the helicopter.
Wolfhound, we have guests. Some stalker is walking right at us. What do we do with him?
Understood, will do.
Wolfhound: A stalker is coming at you. He seems to have shot our snipers. Stay alert, he's coming from the Bar.
Wolfhound: Yes, send a couple of guys to cover your backsides.
Wolfhound: Don't you know what to do with witnesses? Finish him. Quietly.
Wolfhound: What's going on there? What's that shooting? Can you hear me?
Wolfhound: Answer, damn it! What's going on there?
Wolfhound: Damn!
Wolfhound: Professor, you're a smart man. Hand over the information and go wherever you like.
Wolfhound: Listen, you scientific idiot, either you give me the results, or you leave here in a plastic bag.
Guys, we've got work. Everyone to the rally point.
Military captain: Stalker, you're approaching the barrier, don't try anything funny. But we're glad to accept any help.
We'll cut down the enemy! Don't be afraid!
Ah, haven't held a saber in ages!
We're going to take down some pretty boys!
Why does everything always happen at the wrong time, huh?
Don't screw it up!
Hey! New meat with us! Just kidding!
High time to stretch our legs, all we've had is vodka!
He's watching us, the creep. - Never mind, he won't be sitting there much longer.
Don't stand there like a post, come over. Let's talk.
Hey, stalker, there's work for a good shot. Come over if you're interested, or get lost.
Up, fighters, our turn has come.
We act according to plan. Forward!
That's it, you're cooked, birds.
You asked for it, damn anarchists!
That's all, they're done.
Hey! Stop, stalker! You're on Freedom territory! This is a routine check, don't sweat it!
Stop, stalker, you can't go in there.
Max! - Listening. - We've got a problem at the farmstead. Gather everyone. - Understood.
Well, forward, stalker! Earn your pay!
Kolyan, you and the guys try to get behind them.
Come over, let's talk!
So, Tolik, you take Baldy and Squint? You'll go in from the right.

Tough and wired folks will be valued and accepted like family only in Freedom. No obligations or ideological nonsense, no morning wake-ups, and minimal prohibition. If you're a real stalker and love the free life among your own kind, join our ranks. Join any time. We accept without breaks or days off, every day and every night.
Stalker, life gives you the chance to find loyal comrades in the ranks of Freedom. Only here will you find those who cover your back and share their last piece of bread.
Veterans and newcomers, if you value your freedom and want to be among friends, join our ranks. Freedom welcomes everyone the roads of the Zone have brought to us.

Want to become a respected stalker? Want to always have loyal friends covering your back? Dream of kicking Duty's stooges? These and many other opportunities will open up for you after joining Freedom's ranks.
The Zone gives you the chance to join the best of the stalker clans. Don't miss your chance to join Freedom. Only here will you be understood and accepted as you are.
The Zone is stalkers. Stalkers are freedom. Be a stalker to the end. Join Freedom.
Join the ranks of Freedom. Together we will preserve the Zone. The only state on the planet of truly free people.
Damn, it's an ambush! Traitor! Let's get out of here, quick!
All clear, you can come over. Did you have any? No, no. First time, is it? Moving out.
Well, Pavlusha, what did you bring us this time? The information is verified. Here's the folder. So, let's see.
Wait a moment. I'll take a measurement and then we'll move on.
Hm, is the detector malfunctioning? Marked One, we need to go in a bit better. I can't make sense of anything here.
Right, it's a little off the scale, but the radiation is normal. We need to go on.
Got the measurements. All that's left is to reach the bunker.

Attention! The power control panel of the bio-installation is locked. Inform the security officer. Unlock the working installations. Unlock the working installations. Unlock the working installations.
Installation S-12 unlocked. Inform the security officer.
Installation S-17 unlocked. Inform the security officer.
Installation TS-23 unlocked. Inform the security officer.
Door locked.
Welcome to our science base!
What brings you to my humble laboratory?
Yes, yes?
All the best!
Glad to have talked with you.
Come again.
Base, this is Volsta-3, no radiation detected. I see fanatics, the group has set off.

Base, this is 056. Absence of radiation confirmed. No large enemy concentrations detected. Landed Boar in the antenna area for recon. Awaiting further instructions. 056, this is Base. Return home. Boar, report the situation. Base, this is Boar. Resistance is minimal. Someone came through here before us. Boar, order: establish a quarantine regime in the antenna area. Destroy violators without hesitation. Base, understood.
So, according to the map, we go right. There's a safe passage underground.
Take that, scum!
Done.
I got one!
Ha! Next!
One down.
Excellent!
Bullseye!

Eagles, listen to me carefully. We're fighting our way to the station. The city is swarming with Monolith men and other vermin. So watch both ways and cover each other. That's all. Check your weapons and we move forward along the alley. Ready in 15 seconds.
Forward!
Guys, moving out. Watch your surroundings carefully, there are plenty of Monolith men here.
Oh, the military. They want to reach the center first and skim the cream. Never mind, we'll be there soon too. Forward, boys.
An underground parking lot. So we're in the center of Pripyat. Move quietly. The Monolith's central base is not far. Forward. We'll be at the station soon.
Ambush! Kill them!
Emergency. Insufficient power to keep the installation operational.
Attention! The energy blocks are damaged. The installation's power level has dropped.
Attention! The installation's power level has dropped to a critical mark.
The Monolith's backup power circuit is on. Power of the Monolith is switched to the O-Consciousness lab.
You made it after all, stalker. And you turned out much stronger than we first thought. Well, it's time to talk. Follow the signal, we'll be waiting for you.
Your goal is here. Come to me.
Your path is coming to an end. Come to me.
Only one will be rewarded.
Your wish will soon be fulfilled. Come to me.
The time has come. I see your wish.
The path is complete, human. Come to me.
Come to me, you will receive what you deserve.

We thank you for revealing to your servants the schemes of our enemies. Illuminate with your radiance the souls of those who gave their lives to fulfill your will. To battle, defenders of the Monolith, to battle! Let us avenge our fallen brothers, may their eternal union with the Monolith be blessed. Death, cruel death to those who reject its sacred power.
